method: Deterministic display of archived data and exact algebra; no simulations or refitting

1A-1B.note: No quantitative values; arrows organize model mechanisms, not estimated causal effects in children.

2A.selector: lambda in {0.5,2.5}; p=.65; equal-weight means of five masters

3A.selector: p in {.75,.85}; all five disclosure levels

3B.note: Var(R)=9(1-p)d[1-(1-p)d]; does not establish a learner variance preference.
3B.selector: exact reward variance at plotted disclosure levels

3C.note: Archived REGRET is binary-minus-graded normalized regret, exactly graded-minus-binary mean disclosure. Units multiply the unit-scale quantities by 100; time windows differ by outcome.
3C.selector: all four claims, with REGRET re-expressed as mean-disclosure difference

4A.note: Bars use midpoint; numerical brackets have width 0.00006103515625, not statistical confidence intervals.
4A.selector: all three bracketed thresholds plus exact static boundary

4B.note: Bars equal-weight master means; dots show individual archived master values.

5A-5C,5E-5F.note: Equal-weight descriptive master means; connected lines guide the eye and do not imply intermediate K values. First success is zero-based and capped at T=2000 for non-events.

6A.note: No isotonic refit or bootstrap. Lines connect observed pooled points only; shaded strip is the archived crossing CI.
6A.selector: dense-range archived pooled responses by architecture; frozen crossing and CI

crossings.censoring_note: Left-censored below the observed dense range; no in-range crossing is estimable and none may be extrapolated.

6B.note: Descriptive master means; masking has action denominator, modal classification has learner denominator.

uncertainty: Imported archived confidence intervals only. Master minima/maxima, where displayed, are descriptive ranges, not confidence intervals.
